bar.name: Same apps as v1 HTML fixtures (PR #33) and as Google A2UI 1.0 JSON; plus 300 blind English requests
bar.pin: a2ui.org v1.0 spec fetched 2026-11-23; candidate PR #35 @ 2ecd7e3

biggest_gap: diff.mjs calls three one-line edits safe that hide or retype saved data (table rename, drop then re-add a field with another type, pick option rename), because it only compares adjacent versions; and no evaluator exists, so the language's meaning is untested.

acceptance.line: >= 90% of 300 blind requests expressible (programs parse and type-check)
acceptance.evidence: 300/300 programs pass the checker; judged full 237 (79%), partial 50, no 13. 43 misses need the outside world (messaging, maps, camera, sync, print); of the 257 in-scope requests 92% are full. 19 requests hit language gaps.
builder's 30 examples: std-style median 159, all 197, custom 243 (max 442). Coverage programs written by other agents: medians 129.5, 164.5 and 117 across the three batches.

acceptance.line: every prefix cut at a line end parses
acceptance.evidence: 340/340 tests reproduced by the critic; valid is not the same as renderable (first UI line is 6-8 lines in; a half-streamed edit must not be applied)

acceptance.line: 30/30 examples parse, type-check, round-trip through the formatter
acceptance.evidence: reproduced; GBNF accepted by llama.cpp's grammar engine

other_notes: Vs the bar: 2.4x-3.4x fewer tokens than A2UI (which has no formulas, drawing or client logic) and 4.9x-5.1x fewer than v1 HTML; critic picks MoldeScript as the best target for a tiny model. Std library is real level 1 (generic); field/toggle/choice/slider/edit sheet still live in an unbuilt runtime.

S2 learnability: ~100 reserved words block everyday names (label, size, unit, month, top, line); wrong fix hint for the `it`/`as` mistake; silent self-comparison in where; checker TypeError after a broken table line; 43% of GBNF-valid random mutations fail the checker (name/scope errors).

Language gaps from coverage: reminders N days before a date and monthly repeats, sort by a formula, grouping across linked tables, minutes/seconds, random, sin/cos, more colours, bulk set/reset, arc fill. Drag and drop, QR, PDF stay out of scope for v0.
